{{Top|leg}}
The '''Institute for Sentient Studies''' was an organization that was based on [[Baraboo]] that specialized in the study of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] plethora of [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] [[Species/Legends|life]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], its director was [[Tamaab Moolis]].
